modelSelection.reason: Async React props, request identity, monotonic lifecycle/CAS and dirty-draft/order negative scenarios require detailed independent review; no subagents.

limitations: Synthetic actual React DOM component; fetch/router and lifecycle parent props are controlled. Does not prove authenticated production lifecycle flow.
No full D1/build repeated per contract; controller deployment gate must build exact pushed candidate and independently reverify production synthetic product.
No shared repository/docs/control state changes, git commit/push, deployment, browser production actions or remote API/database/provider/credit calls.
Effect follows confirmed fresh server props; no optimistic lifecycle update before server action succeeds.
